data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of GBP 8.2 million in prior year reserves for the 2021 calendar year. This deterioration was primarily driven by an increase of GBP 8.4 million related to US Winter storm Uri on the 2020 year of account, alongside a general increase in non-catastrophe claims estimates. The syndicate's business is classified as reinsurance accepted, primarily covering US property catastrophe risks.
